title: Creatively Create
description: A modpack created to because I felt that there weren't many FABRIC create-centric modpacks for the post-production update.
body:
"A heavy, Create-Centric Modpack Containing Almost Every Create Addon and Also encourages exploration containing mods like [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) and [Deeper And Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker)."

_The Creator of This Modpack Is not responsible for any loss of sanity while trying to make machines._

With this modpack, you can colonise the entire solar system and dimensions!
## Features:

-  The overworld looks completely different, with structure mods like [Towns & Towers](https://modrinth.com/mod/towns-and-towers), [CTOV](https://modrinth.com/mod/ct-overhaul-village), [Create: LTAB](https://modrinth.com/datapack/create-let-the-adventure-begin). 
  
-  There's also [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) which adds ~90 Biomes using vanilla blocks and [Geophilic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/geophilic) to add a tiny touch to the vanilla biomes.
  
-  [Countered's Terrain Slabs](https://modrinth.com/mod/countereds-terrain-slabs) Mod makes the terrain have well, slabs.

-  At the core of the modpack is [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric), Paired with countless addons ranging from [cool conductors](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails) to [Nuclear Reactors](https://modrinth.com/mod/createnuclear).

-  The newly released mod, [Railways Untold](https://modrinth.com/mod/railways-untold) is great for exploration as it generates infinite create tracks, going from caves to different biomes.

  
## FAQ
-  Q- What happens if I have any issue? 
  
  A- Kindly report them to the linked discord server with the issue you are facing and your minecraft log and I will see the issue and update the modpack accordingly and if you know which mod is causing the issue, It's best to also inform the author of the respective mod.

-  Q- What if I have a great mod suggestion?

  A- You can also put that suggestion in the discord server!

-  Q- Will there ever be a version for Forge/Neoforge?

  A- Nope. I made this modpack since there weren't much create modpacks for fabric. For neoforge/Forge, There's great modpacks like FXNT Create 3 or Perfect world: Post Production.

Modlist- You may find the list of mods when you click on any version of the modpack.

NOTE: If you want to play superflat, disable terrain mods like geophilic, terralith, tectonic and terraphilic as those mods make it generate normal worlds even in superflat.

Ending Statement- 
Do expect breaking changes as I try to make a good modpack and provide all of you a great experience.
Makes for a very great experience playing create mod! especially with friends!
Thanks to all the mod makers for creating these awesome mods!
